name: llm-wiki
description: Personal LLM knowledge base and TLDR ingestion pipeline.

scripts.compile:wiki: sh -c 'npm run build --silent && node dist/src/wiki/compile-file.js "$@" && npm run verify:publish' --
scripts.ingest:wiki: sh -c 'npm run build --silent && node dist/src/wiki/ingest-handoff.js "$@" && npm run verify:publish' --
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc README.md index.md _config.yml ".github/**/*.yml" "chatgpt-project/**/*.md" "docs/**/*.md" "schema/**/*.json" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "sources/**/*.md" "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "tests/fixtures/**/*.json" "wiki/**/*.md"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc README.md index.md _config.yml ".github/**/*.yml" "chatgpt-project/**/*.md" "docs/**/*.md" "schema/**/*.json" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "sources/**/*.md" "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "tests/fixtures/**/*.json" "wiki/**/*.md"
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run validate:site
